subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased bundle of 14 executable GitHub Action revisions be approved for the repository's secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and agent workflows?
rationale: The code changes are mechanically coherent, but approving new third-party executable revisions inside privileged workflows is a repository trust decision that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Audit and approve the exact head
options.body: Rebase, verify every SHA against its intended upstream release, inspect permission-sensitive diffs, and merge only after the relevant workflow checks complete successfully.

options.title: Split by trust boundary
options.body: Pause this grouped PR and update credential, publishing, scanning, and ordinary setup actions in smaller independently auditable pull requests.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the exact head
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify every SHA against its intended upstream release, inspect permission-sensitive diffs, and merge only after the relevant workflow checks complete successfully.
